Concessions at Tramway

Tramway sells through Glasgow Life, whose concession rate is published per show — usually as the second figure in a listing such as £20/£12.

Concession

Full-time students; people aged 60 and over; and recipients of Jobseeker's Allowance, Disability Living Allowance, Personal Independence Payment or Employment & Support Allowance. Photographic proof of entitlement may be asked for.

Chosen at the time of booking. One concession or discount per ticket.

Fees

Transaction fees apply: £1.50 online, £1.75 by phone. Exchanges, where allowed, are £1 per ticket.
